verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents programmatic, non-UI paths it can be driven through from automation: a RESTful API with an OpenAPI 3.1 spec, access tokens, and deploy-notification tracking meant to be triggered on every release. A Terraform provider is also mentioned for managing projects as code. None of the evidence explicitly documents CI usage, such as a pipeline guide, an official CLI, or a CI action, so headless/CI automation is implied rather than demonstrated. Missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. a pipeline action or documented source-map/deploy upload step in CI), explicit headless/CI workflow docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
